scope: Private fixed native FS/inode/fencing continuation; not ordinary AgentStore, root admission, DMS128 or migration
core_decisions_owned_by_HIA: all saved request/nonce/call/action correlation and terminal status
failed-stat orphan retention while any tracked inode mask is held
orphan LIFO consume-before-one-close and first-close-errno recording
all dynamic workspace requirements and permanent rejection
fixed_mechanics: three disjoint guarded mappings/contexts with source/output/workspace RO between calls
actual Linux syscalls from the unchanged passed 23-primitive FS body
private USER and CHILD source channels
actual u32 return, role, per-role serial and full source/output/workspace extent capture
GROW preserves the exact immutable current input and never re-enters a producer
static RX ELF plus RW data; no W+X mapping
partial transport I/O and transport-only EINTR retries
fatal process exit releases kernel descriptors; no synthesized successful peer reply

external_transport.input: u64le raw byte length followed by a raw 256B USER command and optional body
external_transport.output: u64le full logical output capacity followed by every output byte
external_transport.externally_supplied_CHILD_headers: always wrapped as USER and rejected by HIA

fields: actual child u32 result (0 for USER)
actual original child input bytes / USER raw bytes
actual child full output capacity (0 for USER)
actual child full workspace capacity (0 for USER)
actual child entry serial (0 for USER)
private_channel.payload: USER raw bytes or CHILD exact issued input + complete actual output + complete actual workspace
private_channel.authority: Issued only by fixed dispatcher. Header agreement alone does not authenticate arbitrary external frames.

fields.6: inode logical handle; zero for OPEN
fields.7: OPEN flags or lock kind 1 shared / 2 exclusive
fields.11: body bytes; raw path for OPEN

user_command.init: Only nonce may be nonzero in addition to magic/command; no namespace primitive executes.

fields.8: phase 1 ready / 2 pending / 3 USER growth / 4 CHILD growth / 5 poisoned
fields.80..96: FS call, syscall sequence, actual native entry serial
fields.104..112: inode call and actual native entry serial
fields.256..319: saved immutable CHILD wrapper during GROW
fields.832..1087: saved terminal header during orphan drain

workspace.growth: Natural checked-u64 and actual allocation limits only; no new global file/row/value quota.

lifetime.deferred_aliases: Inherited actual inode HIA owner; close only after the inode group has no masks.
lifetime.failed_stat_orphans: Retain all orphan FStokens until no tracked mask remains; close LIFO, remove token before request, never retry close on errno.
lifetime.retire_precondition: Private inode owner requires the retiring logical row to have no owned masks. This is not a reduced public AgentStore close API.
lifetime.unknown: Missing actual child completion produces no synthetic ACK; fatal process termination ends all OS ownership.
not_yet_supported: complete ten-table namespace and all31 operation ordinary service

development_validation.full_byte_paired: return + all output + all workspace + source readonly + guard bytes; no field masks
development_validation.actual_physical_injected_fault_scope: strace changes actual fstat/close returns in explicitly named fault controls; not claimed spontaneous kernel errors.
development_validation.three_role_replay: Every actual entry is recomputed on retained CoreVM and child wrapper equals the completed actual role/source/output/workspace. No cached correctness result.
